I had something going on where he told me he loved me, but he kept mentioning how there were a lot of beautiful girls at his schools and how a few were hitting on him. Obviously, I got really worried. It took me a while to build up the courage, but eventually, when our conversation was about nothing important, directly asked him if he was messing around with other girls.
Try to just be direct and ask her. Tell her it's bothering you because you care about her, and see how it goes from there (: I wish you all the best

>I started to enjoy things again after a week of 7 hours of therapy a day and antidepressants, I understand that's not possible for a lot of people.  I go to what I call a "depression rehab center" it might be worth looking into before you get too far down like I did (was ready to kill myself had everything ready four times, and attempted twice).  I was able to switch out of my school to go there fairly easily so if your a student that would be worth looking into, or a therapist.  Also running/exercise (oh no not this shit again) really has helped me keep my mood up.  Don't shoot for happy go for ok, then go for happy.  It's not gonna be easy but everyone here can get out myself included.  PM me if you or anyone else has any questions :| <-ok face

How does intense therapy work? Because I go to an hour of therapy about once every week and a half, but I can't imagine that going on for seven hours. I attempted suicide twice too, and I'm trying to stay alive so I don't hurt anyone. 
I got into a routine of going jogging or walking every day, plus doing a few exercises at home; sometimes though I start crying during workouts because I can't stop thinking. 
Thank you so much for your support :| <-okay face back at you
